records.statement: STROBE asks observational studies to report statistical methods, methods for confounding, subgroup and interaction analyses, missing-data handling, design-specific handling such as sampling strategy or matching, sensitivity analyses, participant missingness, and unadjusted and adjusted estimates with precision.

CONSORT 2025 asks randomized trials to make the protocol and statistical analysis plan accessible, report analysis populations and missing-data handling, distinguish prespecified from post-hoc additional analyses, and report primary-outcome effect estimates with precision and participant counts.

STARD 2015 asks diagnostic-accuracy studies to report methods for accuracy estimation, handling of indeterminate and missing results, prespecified versus exploratory variability analyses, cross-tabulation against the reference standard, and accuracy estimates with precision.

TRIPOD+AI asks prediction-model studies to report missing-data handling, data use and partitioning, predictor handling, model type and rationale, internal validation, performance measures such as discrimination and calibration, model-performance estimates with confidence intervals, and enough model specification to permit external prediction and evaluation.
